candidates.route: 総容量と空き容量を取得し計算で求める
args: Get-WmiObject -Query 'SELECT TotalPhysicalMemory, FreePhysicalMemory FROM Win32_ComputerSystem' | ForEach-Object { $total = $_.TotalPhysicalMemory / 1MB; $free = $_.FreePhysicalMemory / 1MB; $usage = 100 - ($free / $total * 100); $usage }
